title: .spec-drive-state.json
description: State file that tracks spec-drive execution progress. Committed to git, collocated with spec artifacts.
$comment: Active project registry: ~/.spec-drive-active.json — format: {activePath: string, name: string, switchedAt: string (ISO 8601)}. Written by /spec-drive:switch. If absent, commands fall back to cwd scan for .spec-drive-state.json.

activeRegistry.title: ~/.spec-drive-active.json
activeRegistry.description: User-scoped active project registry written by /spec-drive:switch. Shared across all terminal sessions and CLIs. Delete to revert to cwd detection.

activePath.description: Absolute path to the spec directory (basePath from .spec-drive-state.json)

switchedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when /spec-drive:switch was last called

basePath.description: Absolute path to the spec directory (e.g., ~/spec-drive-projects/my-project/spec)

phase.description: Current phase in the spec-driven development lifecycle

runId.description: Stable execution run identity for worktree and attempt names

planRevision.description: Approved tasks.md byte hash that introduced the executable task plan

taskOrder.description: Original approved task order by canonical taskId

currentTaskId.description: Canonical taskId currently being dispatched, reported, or accepted

activeAttemptId.description: Attempt currently active or awaiting manual recovery

approvals.description: Explicit artifact approvals keyed by artifact name

taskStates.description: Execution state keyed by canonical taskId

legacyMigratedAt.description: Timestamp when unambiguous legacy taskIndex state was converted in place

mode.description: Execution mode. normal = approval gates between phases. auto = definition phases still stop for review, then execution may proceed autonomously after task planning.

taskIndex.description: 0-based index of the current task in tasks.md

totalTasks.description: Total number of tasks in tasks.md

taskIteration.description: Retry count for the current task. Resets to 1 when advancing to next task.

maxTaskIterations.description: Maximum retries per task before stopping

globalIteration.description: Total loop iterations across all tasks

maxGlobalIterations.description: Safety cap on total loop iterations to prevent infinite token burn

awaitingApproval.description: Whether the current phase is waiting for user approval before proceeding

parallelGroup.description: Tracks parallel [P] task batch execution state

startIndex.description: First task index in the parallel batch

endIndex.description: Last task index in the parallel batch

taskIndices.description: All task indices in this parallel batch

isParallel.description: Whether this batch is currently executing in parallel

requirementsSha.description: SHA of requirements.md at time tasks.md was generated

designSha.description: SHA of design.md at time tasks.md was generated

coordinator.description: Lightweight coordinator state for early-phase orchestration decisions

active.description: Whether a coordinator-managed subflow is currently active

mode.description: Current coordinator path or fallback mode

reason.description: Why the coordinator activated or why it remained/degraded to sequential flow

degraded.description: Whether active coordination degraded back to sequential flow

taskResults.description: Results keyed by task index. Tracks status and errors for completed/failed tasks.
